verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing's own docs state there is an API to submit disputes on card transactions and monitor them through to resolution, so the core of programmatic filing and tracking is first-party. The pack has only that one line, though, and none of the story's specific sub-capabilities are shown. Missing for 10: network reason codes, evidence submission mechanics, provisional credit handling, dispute status webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution

citations.quote: Stripe offers a guided Dashboard process and an API to submit disputes and monitor them through to resolution.
